title: The Eatwell Guide and Balanced Diets

flashcard_questions.q: A healthy eating model published by Public Health England showing the types and proportions of foods needed for a well-balanced diet.
Foods rich in complex carbohydrates that provide the body with a slow, steady release of energy. Examples include bread, rice, pasta, and potatoes.
A type of carbohydrate found in plant foods that the body cannot digest. It helps the digestive system work properly and reduces the risk of heart disease and some cancers.

flashcard_questions.a: A diet that excludes all animal products including meat, fish, dairy, eggs, and honey.
The inability to digest lactose, a sugar found in milk and dairy products, causing symptoms such as bloating, cramps, and diarrhoea.
